$comment: Lowe's (US home improvement retailer) is behind Akamai, which answers every page fetch from this network with 'Access Denied' (plain HTTP, headless Chrome, and the AI engine's page fetch all fail, and the page is not reachable with ai_fetch browser either). So this site uses the default engine (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance) with ai_fetch web_search: the service sends only the product URL to the search model (APP_AI_CRAWLER_SEARCH_MODEL, sonar), which answers with the title, description, specs and features and cites its sources. The shop is never contacted (source.site_contacted false). The values are not checked against a page, so the response carries AI_UNVERIFIED and price and stock may be out of date. The config has no selectors, so there is no fixture page; the end-to-end test replays the recorded search answer. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http, browser (headless Chrome), ai_fetch http and ai_fetch browser: ACCESS_DENIED; web_search: SUCCESS, unverified, 16 specs and 4 features at 602+739 tokens; duckduckgo, mojeek, yandex: SEARCH_PROVIDER_BLOCKED; yahoo: SEARCH_PROVIDER_ERROR; brave: not tried, no key. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key on the instance. Checked against the Nutmeg Hickory Handsculpted product URL on 2026-11-19.
